title: Cochain normalization of the canonical finite scalar and pullback square
statement: For a prime l, finite extension E/Q_l, morphism f:X→Y, n≥0 and a flat-term K-flat complex P of completed integral modules on Y whose ordinary geometric inverse image is also flat-term K-flat, the canonical integralFiniteScalarPull(f,n) at Q(P), followed by finite pullback of the finite scalar computation isomorphism at Y and the intrinsic geometric computation isomorphism, equals scalar reduction of the completed geometric computation isomorphism, followed by the finite scalar computation isomorphism at X, Q of the termwise ordinaryFiniteScalarPull square, and Q of pullbackTensorLevelIntrinsic. The ordinary square is defined by left-adjoint uniqueness from finiteScalarRestrictionDirect, the actual finite direct-image/scalar-restriction identity. No RealizationModel, coefficient sequence, quotient-presentation comparison, or integral-reduction/pullback comparison is assumed.

source.place: The scalar/pullback comparison on a flat-term K-flat representative in the finite-evaluation argument; Stacks Tags 07A6, 06YY and 0D6E.

Apply finiteScalarPullPbcNormalization to compute the remaining pbc square on the ordinary complex.

Use finiteScalarReductionCounitNormalization on the pulled-back good complex and naturality of the X scalar presentation at the completed geometric computation factor. Cancel the source scalar presentation and unfold the unchanged definition of integralFiniteScalarPull.
